description.value: Suncoast Cycles is a bicycle shop in Powell River, BC, carrying brands including Giant and Trek with floor stock and order-for-pickup options. The shop regularly runs clearance sales on bikes and stocks cycling accessories and gear from brands like DHaRCO. It serves as a local hub for cyclists on the northern Sunshine Coast.
